title: Basic SELECTS [Specific columns]
description:
In SQL, to select only **specific columns**, you use the syntax
```sql
SELECT column1, column2,...... FROM table_name;
```
This is very important for selecting data you _actually care about_. Kinda like selecting only the eldest and youngest child, not the middle.
---
## Assignment:
BWS realized we don't really care about our users bucket _names_. Make your SELECT statment only select the type and size columns.
setupCode: CREATE TABLE buckets (name TEXT, type TEXT, size TEXT); INSERT INTO buckets VALUES ('backups', 'directory', '123gb'); INSERT INTO buckets VALUES ('homework', 'files', '144142gb'); INSERT INTO buckets VALUES ('test', 'nothing', '0b'); INSERT INTO buckets VALUES ('BWSdata', 'we need stuff for ourselves, ok?', '400TB');
expectedOutput:
type | size
directory | 123gb
files | 144142gb
